user.title: Connect DTE usage data
user.description: Create a usage data link in your DTE account (Usage → Usage History → share your Green Button data), then paste it here. Anyone with the link can see your usage, so it is stored as a secret.

data_description.electric_plan: The plan on your electric bill. It sets the prices used for costs and the peak sensors; you can change it later.

reconfigure.title: Replace the usage data link
reconfigure.description: Create a new link in your DTE account and paste it here. Imported history is kept.

error.invalid_link: That doesn't look like a DTE usage data link. Copy the whole link from your DTE account.
error.link_not_working: DTE didn't return usage data for this link. It may have expired; create a new one in your DTE account.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach DTE. Try again in a few minutes.
error.different_account: This link belongs to a different DTE account. Add it as a new entry instead.

abort.already_configured: This DTE account is already set up.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The new link works. History and settings are kept.

data_description.electric_plan: Used for new costs and the peak and price sensors. Costs already imported keep the plan they were priced with.
data_description.update_hours: DTE publishes usage a day or two late, so a few times a day is plenty.

options.d1_11: Standard time of day, peak weekdays 3–7 pm (D1.11)
options.d1_2: Time of day, peak weekdays 11 am–7 pm (D1.2)

link_not_working.title: DTE usage data link stopped working
link_not_working.description: DTE no longer returns usage data for the saved link; it may have expired. Create a new link in your DTE account (Usage → Usage History), then open Settings → Devices & services → DTE Energy → ⋮ → Reconfigure and paste it. Imported history is kept.
